html:
As I send Once Dead to my editor today, I must bring the Early Reader Feedback program to an end. Thank you to all of you fans who were willing to read the rough draft. Your feedback will lead to a much improved finished product.
Thanks again.
Richard

comments.author: Julia
comments.html: Oh, how much I loved The Rho Agenda books! Thank you so much for a great time I had reading it! I can’t wait for your next book series!!!

comments.author: Harold T.
comments.html: I am just finishing the third book in the Rho agenda series and I enjoyed them immensely. Glad to hear there will be more. I am hooked Richard, can’t wait for the next book.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Harold. Glad you enjoyed them.
Richard

comments.author: D. smith
comments.html: Thank you so much for the chance to read the rough draft. It was amazing just like first 3. The only problem was that it wasn’t long enough!

comments.author: Robert L
comments.html:
I thoroughly enjoyed all three books in the Rho trilogy, Richard. Thank you for allowing me to participate in your Early Reader Feedback program. Also loved Once Dead; wouldn’t have changed a thing. I continue to recommend you to anyone who’ll listen, and more than one Jack Reacher fan is anxiously awaiting Once Dead. One request: please keep Second Ship/Rho going, the characters and story are gold.

Regards,
Rob L

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thanks Rob. I appreciate the promotion. Don’t worry, I will be revisiting the Rho characters once I’m done with the Jack and Janet prequels.
Richard

comments.author: Paul Keyworth-Wright
comments.html: Read the first few chapters of once dead but missed out on the extra ones……so I am champing at the bit for the whole story, I haven’t been so impatient for an author to write his next book since I first started reading Mr King in the seventies…! Thank you for such engaging stories.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thanks Paul,
I’m glad you enjoyed the intro.
Richard
